predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: the theocratic state of Hanzhong ('Hanning'): a 100 km circle round Hanzhong, cut at the Sichuan border so that liu-zhang's Yi Province (Sichuan, Chongqing, 188-214) is not drawn twice

successors.name: Cao Cao
successors.text: the theocratic state of Hanzhong ('Hanning'): a 100 km circle round Hanzhong, cut at the Sichuan border so that liu-zhang's Yi Province (Sichuan, Chongqing, 188-214) is not drawn twice

successors.name: Shu Han
successors.text: Bazhong, where Zhang Lu 'retreated' when Yangping Pass was taken and from which he came out to surrender (Battle of Yangping page)

ledger.x: 215: PAGE SILENT on the date and on how Zhang Lu held Bazhong.
215: Cao Cao's campaign reaches Zhang Lu's land.

wars.name: Hanzhong campaign of 215
wars.outcome: Cao Cao took Yangping Pass, Zhang Lu retreated to Bazhong and surrendered; Cao Cao held Hanzhong, Liu Bei took Bazhong.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; Hanzhong Commandery is named, not delimited, and the Bazhong refuge (215) is a name, not an area.
